name: GW-501516
aliases: Cardarine, Endurobol, GSK-516, GW 1516, GW-1516, GW-516, GW1516, UNII-7I2HA1NU22
summary: GW501516 is a PPARδ receptor agonist that was invented in a collaboration between Ligand Pharmaceuticals and GlaxoSmithKline in the 1990s. It entered into clinical development as a drug candidate for metabolic and cardiovascular diseases, but was abandoned in 2007 because animal testing showed that the drug caused cancer to develop rapidly in several organs.

pharmacology.text: GW501516 is a selective agonist of the PPARδ receptor. It displays high affinity (Ki = 1 nM) and potency (EC50 = 1 nM) for PPARδ with greater than 1,000-fold selectivity over PPARα and PPARγ. In rats, binding of GW501516 to PPARδ recruits the coactivator PGC-1α. The PPARδ/coactivator complex in turn upregulates the expression of proteins involved in energy expenditure.

uses.en: It has no approved medical use. It is sold illegally, often as Cardarine, for endurance and fat loss, and it is banned in sport.
uses.zh: 它沒有核准的醫療用途。它常以 Cardarine 之名非法販售，用於提升耐力和減脂，並被列為運動禁藥。
uses.zhHans: 它没有核准的医疗用途。它常以 Cardarine 之名非法贩售，用于提升耐力和减脂，并被列为运动禁药。

sideEffects.en: Very little is known about its effects in people. In animal tests it caused cancer to develop quickly in several organs, which is why its development was stopped.
sideEffects.zh: 對它在人體的作用所知極少。在動物試驗中，它使多個器官迅速長出癌症，這正是它被停止開發的原因。
sideEffects.zhHans: 对它在人体的作用所知极少。在动物试验中，它使多个器官迅速长出癌症，这正是它被停止开发的原因。

fact.en: GW-501516 was dropped in 2007 after it caused cancers in animal tests. In 2013 the World Anti-Doping Agency took the rare step of warning athletes directly about its dangers.
fact.zh: GW-501516 在 2007 年因動物試驗中引發癌症而被放棄。2013 年，世界反禁藥組織罕見地直接向運動員發出警告，說明它的危險。
fact.zhHans: GW-501516 在 2007 年因动物试验中引发癌症而被放弃。2013 年，世界反禁药组织罕见地直接向运动员发出警告，说明它的危险。
